parsed.name: SHFQA量子分析仪读出模块
parsed.description: 用于苏黎世仪器 SHFQA 量子分析仪的读出功能模块，面向量子比特/多能级态测量。它可配置结果记录器、写入和读取加权积分权重、运行读出采集，并管理与测序器、波形存储器和触发相关的读出流程。
parsed.description_en: A readout functional module for the Zurich Instruments SHFQA quantum analyzer, intended for qubit and multistate measurement. It configures the result logger, writes and reads weighted integration weights, runs readout acquisition, and manages readout-related sequencer, waveform memory, and trigger operations.
